## 4. Not done / deviations

- Chat's notice says "pick one from the agent picker" (`staleLink.bodyPicker`) rather than "from the table below", since Chat has no table. The kind/id shape is otherwise identical.
- A `kb`-less detail link uses a third variant, "The Knowledge base link carried no id — pick one from the table below.", because interpolating an empty id read badly.
- The evaluators/online/experiment fallbacks to the first row still happen after the param is stripped, which is the plain no-param behaviour the brief allows; only Chat refuses a substitute.
- DetailView treats every 4xx except 401 as gone; 401 stays an auth error.
- Probe script is kept alongside the evidence (`stale_links.mjs`) rather than in the repo, as the frontend gate has no test runner.
